node.title: Compensación de externalidades de red
node.summary: Recognise or support a contributor whose value is captured elsewhere in a network.

relations: The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.
La analogía no verifica cifras históricas del fondo ni prueba que toda línea deficitaria cree valor neto para la red.
The network example suggests a JUBAP leverage point in the funding and transfer rule itself: make the contributing node sustainable so the wider service can work.
Es aplicación propuesta de la lectura; no implica que JUBAP diseñara la reforma histórica de Barcelona.
The historical Chicontepec account helps separate local capability formation from programme-level and territorial outcomes; improvement at one level cannot stand in for the others.
La crónica se refiere a 2013. No se trasladan sus cifras, juicios o condiciones regulatorias al estado actual.
The second-order HID programme can extend the incentive question by testing how contribution recognition and withdrawal rights change feasible collective outcomes.
HID2-01…10 están propuestos y no ejecutados; un toy algebraico no demuestra aceleración económica real.
A later economic question is whether correcting attribution changes effective withdrawal and allocation rights, rather than only symbolic credit.
El programa es propuesto; no aporta estimaciones causales sobre empresas reales.
